column1: # tests/fm-test-quarantine.tsv - known pre-existing host-sensitive test
# failures that an upstream sync validation must exclude, never silently.
# One entry per line, four TAB-separated columns:
#   <script>
#   script     tests/<name>.test.sh path (must exist in this repo)
#   signature  a grep-able substring of the failure's output
#   reason     why this failure is host-sensitive and pre-existing on main
#   owner      the backlog item id that owns fixing (and thereby removing) the entry
# Owned by bin/fm-test-run.sh's --exclude-quarantined flag: it drops exactly
# the scripts named here from a selection and prints one FM_TEST_QUARANTINED
# line per skip plus an FM_TEST_QUARANTINE_SUMMARY, so a quarantined skip is
# never hidden. Every entry is a failure reproduced on origin/main, cited in
# its reason column; a test whose failure is fixed should be removed from this
# file by the owner item that lands the fix, so the quarantine can only shrink.
# docs/configuration.md "Upstream autosync" is the one prose owner of this
# contract; bin/fm-test-run.sh's header owns the exact flag and file mechanics.
